name: Peter Meijer
summary:
Peter James Meijer (, MY-ər; born January 10, 1988) is an American politician and business analyst who served as the U.S. representative from Michigan's 3rd congressional district from 2021 until 2023. He is a member of the Republican Party.
Meijer is a member of the Meijer family, the owners of the Meijer superstore chain.
